# VM compat matrix — third-party programs on the x86 VM

*Generated by `scripts/compat_track.py` — do not hand-edit the table.*

The VM tracks its emulator-readiness by running outside programs against
**standard device contracts** (see `scripts/compat/manifest.json`). Each
row is one program: in-house controls prove the harness, third-party
sources probe the intake path. A failing row is a *finding*, not a test
failure — its reason becomes a kanban gap card.

Run: `python scripts/compat_track.py` (per-entry step budget 300,000)

## Tier ladder

| tier | meaning |
|------|---------|
| control | in-house program; harness health |
| tier1 | third-party source assembled **and ran** on our VM |
| tier2 | third-party source blocked — reason below is the named gap |

## Coverage summary

- **syscalls observed**: 8/31 — never observed: BRK, DISK_READ, DISK_WRITE, EXEC, FREE, GETROLE, GETTIMEOFDAY, KILL, MALLOC, MOUSE_READ, NET_RECV, NET_SEND, READDIR, RTC_GETTIME, SBRK, SERIAL_READ, SERIAL_WRITE, TRAIN_GET_RESULT, TRAIN_START, TRAIN_STATUS, UNAME, UNLINK, YIELD
- **unhandled interrupts invoked**: none

| device contract | status | observed | via |
|------------------|--------|----------|-----|
| 8250 UART serial | wired | yes | port:0x3F8 |
| 8254 PIT system timer | wired | no | always-on |
| 8259-style PIC dispatch | wired | no | - |
| VGA text buffer @0xB8000 | wired | yes | memory-diff |
| PS/2 keyboard | wired | no | - |
| PS/2 mouse | wired | no | - |
| CMOS/RTC | wired | no | - |
| ATA-like block storage | wired | yes | syscall:OPEN |
| virtio-style NIC | wired | no | - |
| FileDevice host-fs bridge | wired | yes | syscall:READ |
| ConsoleDevice engine sink | wired | no | engine-tier |
| BIOS video services INT 10h | planned | no | - |
| BIOS keyboard services INT 16h | planned | no | - |
| BIOS disk services INT 13h | planned | no | - |
| real-mode IVT + segment model | planned | no | - |
| scripted input injection (keyboard) | planned | no | - |
